_doc: Per-vendor feed config. key = short vendor handle. sf_vendor_name must match PBSI__Default_Vendor_Name__c so availability links to our catalog. columns maps OUR fields -> the vendor's header names (case-insensitive, fuzzy-contains); use a number for headerless column index. full=true means the feed is a COMPLETE availability list (enables drop-off => discontinued detection); set false for partial/delta feeds.

prosol.name: Prosol
prosol.note: We already scrape Prosol live (check-prosol-price.js); this feed is a fallback/cross-check, treat as partial.
